dimensions.assessment: Directly involves U.S. executive officials at the International Monetary Fund and indirectly affects international financial governance regarding Chinese currency.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Treasury shall instruct the United States Governor of, and the United States Executive Director at, the International Monetary Fund

dimensions.assessment: Mandates formal U.S. opposition at the IMF unless stringent conditions and executive certifications regarding Chinese compliance are satisfied.
dimensions.evidence: use the voice and vote of the United States to oppose any increase in the weight of the Chinese renminbi... unless

Restricts U.S. voting posture in an international financial institution and imposes reporting and certification duties on the Treasury Secretary.
dimensions.evidence: unless the Secretary of the Treasury has submitted... a written report which includes a certification

dimensions.assessment: Includes a statutory sunset provision terminating the restriction 10 years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Section 2 shall have no force or effect beginning 10 years after the date of the enactment of this Act.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs U.S. officials at the International Monetary Fund to oppose increasing the weight of Chinese currency in Special Drawing Rights baskets unless specific certification conditions are met.
